OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / TIKITA: https://ra.co/reviews/18921 — the four Body 2:2 Mind tracks were screened. natural/electronic.system. — Emersione was retained from the exact review's winding bass and syncopated drums.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / STROBOSCOPIC ARTEFACTS: https://ra.co/reviews/22376 — ten Flowers From The Ashes tracks were screened. Lucy — Starving The Mind was retained from the exact review's polyrhythmic techno and modulated-horn account.
OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / TRESOR: https://ra.co/reviews/15942 — twelve Beyond The Hypnosis tracks were screened. Jonas Kopp — Ironcry was retained from the exact interwoven 3/4 and 4/4 drum description.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / LIVITY SOUND: https://ra.co/reviews/21852 — four Pour Le Club! tracks and adjacent references were screened. Simo Cell — Stop The Killing (Intello Mix) was retained from the exact counter-intuitive syncopation account.

ADDITIONAL WINDOWS: current Bandcamp electronic pages, Robert Hood's June 2026 Internal Empire reissue, Syncopated Records, Isla/Crespi Drum Syndicate and older RA broken-beat searches were screened. Already retained identities, release-only claims and results without exact-track structural evidence were excluded.
explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 47 named tracks and releases across current releases, adjacent and emerging artists and labels, and overlooked catalogue windows; metadata and attributed descriptions only, with zero audio auditions.
exclusions: All 14 canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects and every untriggered PARKED revisit were excluded. Exact identities and primary discovery lanes retained in Runs 53–78 were not recycled.
The protected internal handoffs Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer remain unavailable; Truth in Noise → Transparency and every other boundary remain available.

No lead was promoted for recency, reputation, genre, novelty, title or technical cleverness. Current-release pages without exact-track rhythmic or structural evidence were retained only as watches or excluded.

Energy, density, space, hypnosis, emotional effect, phrase structure, harmonic relation, perceived pulse and mixability remain unknown. Attributed descriptions of metre and syncopation are evidence, not transition or flow verdicts.
rankedLeadSummary: 1. Jonas Kopp — Ironcry: strongest explicit metric construction, with interwoven 3/4 and 4/4 drums.
2. Entrañas & Kontronatura — Eris: strongest adjacent-world exact account, adding Ecuadorian bomba and tribal rhythms around 6/8 and triplets.
3. natural/electronic.system. — Emersione: strongest slower-tempo syncopated-drum hypothesis from an overlooked Tikita compilation.
4. Simo Cell — Stop The Killing (Intello Mix): strongest counter-intuitive syncopation lead from Livity Sound.
5. Lucy — Starving The Mind: strongest polyrhythmic-techno lead from an overlooked Italian compilation.
